mappings.reason: ADRs 0001/0004/0013/0028: five canvas SDF graph families execute through the shared offline importer and renderer-owned pixel-space field. Preserve signed distances, central-difference normals, distance/hit/endpoint ray outputs, implicit screen UV, typed default absence, aliases, portable archives and live renderer policies. Reachable vertex use rejects; Light graph execution retains its existing dependency. Physical GPU, native heap, foreign hosts and owner visual acceptance remain separate.
